## Resume bullets (numbers filled in from this run)
- Automated quarterly extraction of Call Report data for 1,067 U.S. banks via the FDIC API using Python, replacing manual data collection with a scheduled pipeline.
- Calculated and benchmarked 6 key performance ratios (ROA, ROE, NIM, noncurrent loans, efficiency, Tier 1 leverage) across 3 peer groups over 26 quarters using SQL window functions.
- Built an early-warning watchlist flagging 280 banks on asset quality, profitability, and capital, delivered as an Excel peer report and dashboard-ready dataset.
